data.narrative:
Kraken Robotics is a public-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The comparable universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The sector encompasses 22 same-stage peers overall.

Peer-median valuation methodology was not applicable. The narrow peer set—filtered by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints necessary for robust triangulation. While 22 Defense & Security peers exist, none satisfied the joint criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier classification simultaneously. An all-sector median approach would introduce material distortion given Kraken's specialized subsector positioning and would not reflect comparable risk or growth profiles.

Given the limited peer density and methodological constraints, this valuation cannot be reliably triangulated using standard multiples-based approaches at this time. Further analysis would require either (1) expansion of the peer set through additional market research in adjacent defense verticals, (2) application of discounted cash flow analysis if forward projections are available, or (3) transaction-based comparables from recent M&A activity in autonomous defense systems. The two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) merit individual review, though their direct comparability to Kraken requires assessment of business model, margin profile, and end-market exposure that lies beyond the present dataset.
